###FINAL###
The salt encases spires lost in time,
Where coral blooms on broken marble steps.
No bell rings out its chimeless rhyme,
Only the tide’s cold whisper softly creeps.
Beneath the surface, ghosts in armor stand,
Guarding halls where light no longer falls.
A drowned empire holds the ocean’s hand,
Within these deep and silent, stony walls.
The currents wash through empty throne rooms now,
Erasing names carved into ancient stone.
The sea has taken every sacred vow,
And claims the city as its own.
So sleep beneath the waves’ eternal keep,
While land above forgets them in its sleep.
